partners.diseaseBName: neurodevelopmental disorder with craniofacial dysmorphism and skeletal defects
partners.mechanism_chain: HNRNPH1 (HGNC:4870) —DISRUPTS→ mRNA splicing (GO:0006397); mRNA splicing (GO:0006397) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal vocalization (HP:0011080); SNRPE (HGNC:10809) —DISRUPTS→ regulation of transcription (GO:0006355); regulation of transcription (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Craniofacial dysmorphism (HP:0000252); regulation of transcription (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal defects (HP:0002650). Haploinsufficiency of HNRNPH1 disrupts mRNA splicing, leading to phenotypes in MONDO:0014027, such as abnormal vocalization. Haploinsufficiency of SNRPE, a component of the spliceosome, disrupts regulation of transcription, contributing to craniofacial dysmorphism and skeletal defects seen in MONDO:0859301. Both genes' dysfunction converge on the fundamental cellular processes of RNA processing and gene regulation.

partners.mechanism_chain: SNRPE (HGNC:10850) —DISRUPTS→ RNA processing (GO:0006355); RNA processing (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Dyskeratosis congenita (HP:0001928); HNRNPA1 (HGNC:4845) —DISRUPTS→ protein aggregation (GO:0051962); protein aggregation (GO:0051962) —LEADS_TO→ Inclusion body myopathy (HP:0003690); protein aggregation (GO:0051962) —LEADS_TO→ Paget disease of bone (HP:0003002); protein aggregation (GO:0051962) —LEADS_TO→ Frontotemporal dementia (HP:0000726). Mutations in SNRPE disrupt RNA processing, leading to Autosomal dominant dyskeratosis congenita.
